import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime,timezone
site=Path('/home/popac/alekpopovic.github.io');book=site/'books/inside-orch'
def git(*args):return subprocess.check_output(['git',*args],cwd=site,text=True).strip()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
baseline='80801c8d3d97a4d8ff78e0fe69f3f902beda00c0'
assert git('branch','--show-current')=='book/inside-orch-000'
assert all(git('rev-parse',ref)==baseline for ref in ['HEAD','main','origin/main'])
assert not git('diff','--cached','--name-only'),'Unexpected staged files'
assert not git('diff','--check')
tracked=git('diff','--name-only').splitlines()
expected={'_config.yml','_data/glossary.yml','_data/updates.yml','scripts/book_catalog.py','scripts/build-books.py','scripts/check-performance.mjs','tests/workspace-editor.spec.js'}
assert set(tracked)==expected,tracked
untracked=git('ls-files','--others','--exclude-standard').splitlines()
extra={'tests/inside-orch.spec.js','_posts/2026-10-13-a-ready-server-may-have-forgotten-your-cluster.md','_posts/2026-10-13-follow-a-resource-limit-all-the-way-to-docker.md','_posts/2026-10-13-an-offline-node-is-not-proof-that-its-workload-stopped.md'}
assert all(p.startswith('books/inside-orch/') or p in extra for p in untracked),'Unrelated untracked work'
assert extra.issubset(set(untracked))
ignored=['book-pages/inside-orch/index.html','assets/books/inside-orch/downloads/inside-orch.pdf','_data/books.json']
assert git('check-ignore',*ignored).splitlines()==ignored
assert not git('ls-files','--',*ignored)
patch=book/'publication/site-adapter/changes.patch'
subprocess.run(['git','apply','--reverse','--check',str(patch)],cwd=site,check=True,capture_output=True,text=True)
excluded=['books/inside-orch/state/execution-tracker.csv','books/inside-orch/publication/site-adapter/final-source-inventory.json'] + ['books/inside-orch/validation/publication/099-final-local-git-inventory-command'+suffix for suffix in ['.json','.stdout.txt','.stderr.txt']]
files=[]
for name in sorted(set(tracked+untracked)-set(excluded)):
 p=site/name
 assert p.is_file() and not p.is_symlink(),name
 assert p.stat().st_size<100*1024**2,name
 assert not name.endswith('.dump'),name
 files.append({'path':name,'bytes':p.stat().st_size,'sha256':sha(p)})
result={'status':'passed','checked_at_utc':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
 'branch':git('branch','--show-current'),'website_baseline_sha':baseline,
 'head_main_origin_main_unchanged':True,'staged_files':[],
 'source_sha':'cbfc94ade5b57e449d6b73bf1485b1c5b1647022',
 'tracked_changed_paths':tracked,'additional_site_paths':sorted(extra),
 'generated_ignored_and_untracked':ignored,'private_database_dumps_excluded_by_gitignore':True,
 'existing_095_adapter_patch_reverse_check':'passed; reads current integrated files without applying changes',
 'snapshot_exclusions':excluded,'snapshot_boundary':'Actual Git-eligible scoped working-tree files at this timestamp. Mutable canonical tracker and this self-index excluded. Later final audit/command records are separate completion evidence and are not retroactively included.',
 'files':files,'file_count':len(files),'total_bytes':sum(x['bytes'] for x in files),
 'git_mutation':'none: no staging, commit, push, PR, merge or deployment',
 'probe_source':Path(__file__).read_text()}
(book/'publication/site-adapter/final-source-inventory.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({k:v for k,v in result.items() if k not in ['files','probe_source']},indent=2))
